import unittest
import closure_calendar as app

class Behavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_year_and_month_boundaries(self):
        self.assertEqual(app.closure_ranges(['2025-12-31', '2026-01-01']), [{'start': '2025-12-31', 'end': '2026-01-01'}])
        self.assertEqual(app.closure_ranges(['2024-03-01', '2024-02-28', '2024-02-29']), [{'start': '2024-02-28', 'end': '2024-03-01'}])
        self.assertEqual(app.closure_ranges(['2025-03-01', '2025-02-28']), [{'start': '2025-02-28', 'end': '2025-03-01'}])
        self.assertEqual(app.closure_ranges(['2024-03-01', '2024-02-29', '2024-02-28', '2024-02-29']), [{'start': '2024-02-28', 'end': '2024-03-01'}])
    def test_duplicates_and_gaps(self):
        days = ['2026-05-03', '2026-05-01', '2026-05-03', '2026-05-02', '2026-05-06']
        self.assertEqual(app.closure_ranges(days), [{'start': '2026-05-01', 'end': '2026-05-03'}, {'start': '2026-05-06', 'end': '2026-05-06'}])
        self.assertEqual(days, ['2026-05-03', '2026-05-01', '2026-05-03', '2026-05-02', '2026-05-06'])
        self.assertEqual(app.closure_ranges(['2026-01-01', '2026-02-02']), [{'start': '2026-01-01', 'end': '2026-01-01'}, {'start': '2026-02-02', 'end': '2026-02-02'}])
    def test_empty_and_single(self):
        self.assertEqual(app.closure_ranges([]), [])
        self.assertEqual(app.closure_ranges(['2026-06-02', '2026-06-02']), [{'start': '2026-06-02', 'end': '2026-06-02'}])

    def test_additional_behavior(self):
        days = ['2026-01-02', '2025-12-31', '2026-01-01', '2026-01-01', '2026-01-05']
        before = list(days)
        self.assertEqual(app.closure_ranges(days), [{'start': '2025-12-31', 'end': '2026-01-02'}, {'start': '2026-01-05', 'end': '2026-01-05'}])
        self.assertEqual(days, before)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

# gallery-closure-ranges

Behavior contract:
closure_ranges(days) accepts a list of valid ISO date strings YYYY-MM-DD in years 2000..2026. Return sorted maximal inclusive runs of consecutive calendar dates as a list of {'start': date_string, 'end': date_string} dictionaries. Duplicate dates count once. Runs may cross month or year boundaries. An isolated date has equal start and end; empty input returns []. Do not mutate the input.

Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.
Use only the Python 3.12 standard library. Keep the interface and leave tests/ unchanged.
